arcs.title: The Duck Waits
arcs.summary: Day 4: A folded note in burnt-sienna ink — the same as the stamp on the orange duck — has been found beneath the duck's base. Text: 'Survey 7. You know.' Lucy turned away from it immediately and retreated to her bed, confirming prior knowledge of the Bandit. The two ducks remain at forty-seven degrees. Day 5 — the final day — should resolve the arc: the Bandit's identity revealed (a trail figure known to Christine and Steve, someone who was at Harlan's Creek the morning of the expedition — a fellow off-roader, a trail-keeping volunteer, or someone connected to the survey markers), Lucy's collusion explained (she met this person on the drive at some earlier point and approved of them), and the forty-seven-degree angle given its final meaning. The resolution should be warm and funny, not sinister — the Bandit is an admirer of the line Christine ran, leaving a small tribute. A third duck, or the return of something from the ridge, may mark the conclusion.
